citations.quote:
Top 5 to avoid in 2026:
1. Opening with pressure. First come, first serve. Last unit. Last price. You haven't asked him anything and you're already squeezing.
3. Pushing an offer below what you just said the owner would take. Usually because you're reviving the deal the previous client walked away from.
4. Ignoring everything except the money. He tells you size, layout, who's living there, what he's already rejected.
5. Not knowing your numbers. Square footage. Price per square foot. His currency.

summary.text: Agents should avoid using pressure tactics such as 'first come, first serve', ignoring client needs aside from budget, offering deals below what the owner will accept, focusing solely on money matters, and not knowing detailed information about listings.
